Metadata.title: Solident Association
Metadata.description: Free oral-health care and prevention for underserved communities in northern Morocco.

Home.title: A smile is everyone's right
Home.intro: Since 2024, young dentists from northern Morocco have brought free dental care and oral-health prevention to the communities that need it most.
Home.mission: Promote oral health through awareness, prevention and dental caravans, with fair access to care.
Home.vision: Make oral health a priority in every citizen's life, and take the culture of volunteering further.

Footer.tagline: Moroccan oral-health association, founded in 2024 in Larache – Ksar El Kébir.
